Position Title: Manager – Management reporting

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Fund Accounting & NAV
• Manage full-cycle accounting for PE funds, SPVs, and holding entities under IFRS/US GAAP/Ind AS
• Prepare and review quarterly NAV calculations, capital account statements, and fund financials
• Handle capital calls, distributions, waterfall calculations, and carried interest computations
• Maintain books for multiple entities with complex fund structures

• Investor Reporting & Compliance
• Prepare quarterly investor reports, capital account statements, and LP communications
• Coordinate with fund administrators to ensure accurate and timely reporting
• Support annual audits, tax filings, and regulatory compliance – SEBI AIF Regulations, FATCA/CRS, FEMA
• Liaise with Big 4 auditors, tax advisors, and legal counsel

• Deal & Portfolio Support
• Work with deal teams on accounting for new investments, exits, and portfolio company valuations
• Review transaction documents for accounting implications – SPA, SHA, term sheets
• Monitor portfolio company reporting and track valuation inputs
• Support GP entity accounting

• Treasury & Operations
• Manage fund-level cash forecasts, banking operations, and FX hedging
• Oversee drawdown notices, distribution calculations, and LP wire processing
• Drive process improvements and automation
• Ensure internal controls and SOX compliance

• Team & Stakeholder Management
• Mentor junior accountants and review their work
• Present financial updates to CFO and senior management

Skills And Attributes For Success

Experience:

• 10-15 years
• CA / CPA / ACCA* qualified; CFA or MBA-Finance is a plus
• 6-10 years* post-qualification experience in PE/VC fund accounting, fund administration, or Big 4 AFS practice
• Strong knowledge of PE fund structures, partnership accounting, and waterfall models
• Hands-on experience with IFRS/US GAAP and SEBI AIF guidelines
• Proficiency in fund accounting systems: Investran, eFront, Allvue, or similar

Preferred:

• Experience with cross-border structures, Mauritius/Singapore SPVs, and tax treaty implications
• Knowledge of alternative investment tax matters – pass-through taxation, Section 9A
• Prior experience working with LPs, custodians, and fund administrators
• Extreme attention to detail and accuracy with large datasets
• Ability to handle multiple funds and tight quarterly reporting deadlines
• High integrity – you’re dealing with investor capital and confidential data
• Comfortable in a fast-paced, lean PE environment with high ownership

About Scalene Livprotec Pvt Ltd:

We, Scalene Livprotec India (SLPL), are an innovative sustainable technology company. Scalene has invented sustainable engineering solutions to tackle the following large-scale problems:

- Lack of safe drinking water Environmental damage to water systems due to sewage, effluent, and desalination
- Greenhouse gas impact and pollution caused by agriculture and biomass waste

For waste - water recovery, we have developed a proprietary system called Tritron. It is currently installed and in operation at select India campuses of large listed Companies.
